tasks.title: Conversation #34
tasks.transcript:
Man: I’m trying to decide whether to get a smartphone or a tablet. What do you think?
Woman: It depends on what you need it for. If you want something portable and easy to use on the go, a smartphone is better.
Man: That’s true. But I like the larger screen on a tablet for watching videos and reading.
Woman: In that case….
Man: I better think about it some more.

questions.stem: What is the man trying to decide between?

options.C: A tablet and a desktop computer

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士正在犹豫选择哪两种物品，属于主旨 / 事实识别题，需抓住对话开头核心选择对象。 选项分析 选项 A：错误。对话未提及 laptop，属于凭空捏造信息的干扰项。 选项 B：正确。男士开头明确说 “decide whether to get a smartphone or a tablet”，直接对应该选项，为原文原句重现。 选项 C：错误。对话未提及 desktop computer，属于无中生有的干扰项。 选项 D：错误。对话未提及 smartwatch，属于信息无关的干扰项。

questions.stem: What reason does the woman give for her suggestion?

options.B: The device is easier to use on the go.
options.C: The device has a larger screen.
options.D: The device has better battery life.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士给出建议的理由，属于事实细节题，需定位女士建议的依据语句。 选项分析 选项 A：错误。对话完全未提及价格更便宜，属于无中生有的干扰项。 选项 B：正确。女士说 “easy to use on the go”，与选项表述完全一致，是直接同义转述。 选项 C：错误。大屏幕是男士喜欢 tablet 的原因，并非女士的建议理由，属于细节错位干扰项。 选项 D：错误。对话未提及电池续航，属于凭空捏造信息的干扰项。
